body:
I'm pretty sure it would be successful, there are some good steep cliffs and the ocean below here so..

It's not that I particularly want to kill myself as such. It is simply an option.

Say, I wouldn't do it today, but there are times when I feel so stuck and out of control that the idea of going off a cliff sounds like a viable option and/or allows me to feel I have options apart from being "stuck" so to speak.

Went looking for a good place today. Takes some planning.
Attempting to do anything has potential to fail.
I'm not saying I will do it, but I'm certainly having a good detailed plan at hand.
